title: Zanzibar Mango Lassi
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Zanzibar Mango Lassi — ripe Zanzibar Dodo mango blended with natural yogurt, honey, and cardamom. A refreshing, cooling drink that captures the island's most famous fruit. Simple, tropical, and completely Zanzibari.
longDesc: Zanzibar's Dodo mango is among the finest mangoes in the world — intensely sweet, fibreless, and deeply fragrant. Blended with local yogurt and cardamom, it produces a lassi of extraordinary quality.
ingredients: 2 large ripe Zanzibar mangoes — peeled and diced
steps: Blend mango, yogurt, water, honey, and cardamom until completely smooth.
chefTips: The ripest, most fragrant mango is the only choice.
cookingScience: Mango contains amylase enzymes that partially break down starch in the yogurt — slightly thickening the drink naturally while the lactic acid in yogurt partially preserves the mango colour.
sustainabilityTips: Zanzibar Dodo mangoes — locally grown, zero food miles.
healthBenefits: Very high vitamin C and beta-carotene.
culturalNote: Zanzibar mango lassi is the island's most refreshing drink — the famous Dodo mango blended with the morning's fresh yogurt, drunk in the shade as the Indian Ocean breeze cools the stone walls of the old town.
